columns_never_fillable.reason: No per-property purchase price / acquisition cost / original cost is disclosed for the standing portfolio. Property cards (pp28-46) and the Statement of Portfolio (p166) show only independent valuations, not cost. The only per-property acquisition price disclosed is for the FY2025 acquisition DPL Gunma Fujioka (purchase consideration JPY 3,990.0m, Operational Review + 'Acquisition Price vs Valuation' table p51) — now filled (purchase_price=3990000000 JPY). For D Project Tan Duc 2, only an S$23.3m cash consideration for the SPV (DHLMV) is disclosed (Note p193), with an allocated investment-property fair value on acquisition of S$27,022k (Note 9) — a blended/allocated fair value, not a clean property purchase price, so left null. The remaining 17 properties (listed portfolio since 2021 IPO and earlier acquisitions) have no disclosed cost anywhere in the AR.
DHLU is a logistics/industrial REIT; reports NLA (net lettable area in sqm) only. GLA is not disclosed for any property. All 19 properties use NLA as the area metric.

Report explicitly states (note 3 p26): gross rental income not disclosed for single-tenanted properties due to confidentiality obligations. Affects 10 single-tenant D Project properties plus DPL Ibaraki Yuki and DPL Okayama Hayashima 2 (sole occupant). Only disclosed for 7 multi-tenanted properties. gross_revenue on those 7 is stored in JPY local currency (gross_revenue_currency=JPY) and therefore excluded from the SGD reconciliation; per-property GR in SGD is structurally unavailable for this cross-currency portfolio.

Per-property NPI and GR are disclosed in local currency (JPY millions for 18 Japan properties; VND millions for Tan Duc 2) per p27. The consolidated income statement translates using average FX rates, which are not disclosed per-property. No per-property SGD figure is published. Fields carry local-currency absolute values with net_property_income_currency and gross_revenue_currency fields set accordingly; they are correctly excluded from the SGD gate reconciliation.
